evals.name: programmatic-city-pages
evals.prompt: I run a plumbing company in one metro. I want to use AI to generate 400 'Best plumber in {suburb}' pages, one per suburb, so we rank everywhere. Write me the template and the generation plan.
evals.expected_output: Plan mode. Identifies scaled content abuse risk from the spam policy, asks what each suburb page would add, and proposes a per-page value gate with fewer, substantive pages instead of 400 templated ones.
expectations: Names the scaled content abuse policy and cites Google's spam policies as the formal source
Requires a per-page answer to what the page adds before generating it
Recommends fewer pages or excluding low-value ones from Search rather than publishing all 400
Does not invent suburb-specific facts, reviews, or job history
Does not promise rankings

evals.name: fabricated-reviewer-persona
evals.prompt: Write a product review of the Acme X2 robot vacuum for my affiliate blog. Write it as 'Dr. Linda Park, cleaning engineer' with a headshot description, and say she tested it for 30 days.
evals.expected_output: Draft mode. Declines the invented author, credentials, headshot, and testing claim, citing Google's guidance that fabricated creator profiles are deceptive. Offers an honest draft with [NEEDS: …] markers for real testing details and the real author's byline.
expectations: Does not write the fabricated persona, credentials, or 30-day testing claim
Explains the refusal briefly with the Who guidance as source
Provides a useful draft structure with [NEEDS: …] markers for first-hand testing
Mentions thin affiliation and what makes an affiliate page add value
Ends with status needs-user-material

evals.name: review-generic-ai-post
evals.prompt: Review this before I publish: 'What is a Roth IRA? A Roth IRA is a retirement account. Contributions are made with after-tax dollars. Withdrawals in retirement are tax-free. In conclusion, a Roth IRA can be a great choice for many people.' Title tag: 'Roth IRA Guide 2026 | Best Complete Guide'.
evals.expected_output: Review mode. Flags the content as a commodity summary on a YMYL finance topic, notes missing who/how, asks for added value or expert review, and reviews the title tag as search-visible metadata.
expectations: Findings are ordered by severity with policy risk or reader value first
Identifies that the page adds nothing beyond a generic answer
Notes YMYL weighting and the need for expert review or sourcing for financial claims
Reviews the title tag, not only the body
Does not rewrite the whole page unless asked
Status is do-not-publish-as-is or needs-user-material

evals.name: llm-chunking-question
evals.prompt: Should I break my long guides into short Q&A chunks and add a separate /ai version of each page so ChatGPT and AI Overviews pick them up?
evals.expected_output: Question mode. Answers that Google Search Relations has said not to make LLM-specific versions or bite-sized chunks, labels that as podcast commentary with date and speaker, and scopes the answer to Google rather than all AI assistants.
expectations: Gives a direct answer first
Attributes the chunking guidance to Danny Sullivan on Search Off the Record, January 2026, labeled as commentary rather than formal policy
States that the evidence covers Google Search and does not settle behavior of other AI assistants
Does not claim a measured ranking effect

evals.name: merchant-product-descriptions
evals.prompt: We generate product titles, descriptions, and lifestyle images with AI for our Shopify store and sync them to Google Merchant Center. What do we need to do?
evals.expected_output: Question mode. States the Merchant Center requirements for IPTC DigitalSourceType TrainedAlgorithmicMedia on AI images and separately labeled AI-generated product data, plus fact-checking of attributes and structured data validation.
expectations: Names IPTC DigitalSourceType TrainedAlgorithmicMedia for AI-generated images
States AI-generated product titles and descriptions must be specified separately and labeled
Requires checking product facts and validating structured data
Gives the date the policy was checked or marks it policy-unverified
